title: 5 Carlow Court, Whitby, office space for lease
description:
Situated between Dundas Street and Hwy 401 in Whitby’s industrial area, 5 Carlow Court is an excellent quality building with an amazing court location, and boasting an immaculate second level office space available for immediate lease.

The double door entryway opens into a bright common area overlooking the adjacent green space, and separates two office wings of approximately 1,500 sq. ft. each. 

The first wing features a large carpeted area that is bright and open, and can be used for reception space or cubicle-style work stations, as well as four private offices. The two larger offices are finished with laminate flooring, with the other two carpeted; and large windows bring in natural light to three of these offices, while the remaining fourth office benefits from a skylight. An eat-in kitchenette and a washroom complete this area.

The second wing also features the same reception-style main area. From here, two separate doors provide access to a large semi-private office divided by a half wall and finished with laminate floors. There are three additional private offices, one carpeted, and the other two finished with laminate floors. Two of the offices have large windows to bring in natural light, while a skylight adds additional brightness to the office which provides access from a secondary door to a hall with yet another kitchenette and washroom. A fourth room in this wing is sound-proofed for potential recording purposes, yet could be used as a storage area, or as a temporary office space.

A perfect opportunity to upgrade your professional office, this space has great potential for accounting firms, sales and marketing companies, real estate brokerages, as well as many other professions, and offers outstanding value with its close proximity to the 401, downtown Whitby, and potential residential, retail, industrial and professional clients.

For more information, or to arrange your private showing, contact Natalia Halenda, of Re/Max Jazz Inc., Brokerage direct at (905) 242-6568.
author: Open House 24
